acceptanceCriteria: RUSTUP_HOME resolution is explicit and validated before isolated cargo scaffolding
Acceptance failure and success paths clean the validated run root without changing release truth
Regression proves missing or invalid toolchain identity fails closed without a network fallback
goal: Ensure public Release adopter and N-1 upgrade acceptance completes with bounded isolated runtime roots and records toolchain identity.
intent: Make post-release adopter acceptance deterministic by binding the isolated Rust toolchain and preventing implicit rustup downloads or unbounded cache growth.
